disease.description: A form of dilated cardiomyopathy, a disorder characterized by ventricular dilation and impaired systolic function, resulting in congestive heart failure and arrhythmia. Patients are at risk of premature death. CMD2C is an autosomal recessive form with variable severity and age of onset ranging from 2 to 20 years. Death in infancy or early childhood may occur in severely affected children.
